name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '0a' is spell_id 0xA (valid spell-id domain range 00h-23h, meaningful ID to preserve, not address residue since fn is at 0x21527). '_basic' descriptor correctly distinguishes the minimal earthquake-family entry from siblings fd2_cast_spell_0b_with_prefx / fd2_cast_spell_0c_with_prefx, which add pre-cast SFX + rising effect. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Spell dispatch-table handler for spell id 0xA (earthquake family, minimal path): a thin wrapper that delegates to the earthquake worker with no pre-cast SFX or animation.
logic_summary: Single delegate call: fd2_cast_earthquake_spell_with_screen_shake(caster, 0xa, n_tgt, tgt_arr). Passes its spell-id literal 0xA hardcoded; no other logic. Registered at index 0xA (offset 0x28) of the spell dispatch table @ 0x51D01. In the original binary it also serves as the shared-tail anchor that siblings 0xB/0xC JMP into after pushing their own spell_id; in the decompiled source the three are separate full wrappers (functionally equivalent). The __CHK(0x14,...) seen in the Ghidra decomp is the Watcom stack-probe prologue artifact, not game logic.
signature: void fd2_cast_spell_0a_basic(int caster, int n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit id; passed through unchanged to the earthquake worker (arg1).
params.reason: Clear, accurate, consistent with sibling wrappers in spell.c; no address residue.

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of targets; passed through to the worker (arg3 = num_targets).
params.reason: Clear abbreviation for number-of-targets, consistent with rest of file; no address residue.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to target unit-id array; passed through to the worker (arg4 = target_id_array).
params.reason: Clear, matches worker's target_id_array semantics and sibling naming; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value (declared void in src). The Ghidra int return is an artifact of the __CHK stack-probe wrapper; the real worker is void and the result is unused.

notes: Thin dispatch-table wrapper, comment is the shared family header '=== Earthquake family (id 0xA-0xC) ===' plus the top-of-file pattern table, both accurate. Ghidra plate is very detailed and fully consistent with src understanding (no contradiction), so plate left unchanged. Worker name fd2_cast_earthquake_spell_with_screen_shake matches between Ghidra and src/spell/spellcin.c. Dispatch table @ 0x51D01 entry idx 0xA = 0x21527 confirmed via read_memory. Siblings JMP shared-tail @ 0x2153B confirmed via xrefs (fd2_cast_spell_0b_with_prefx @0x21895, fd2_cast_spell_0c_with_prefx @0x21ad4).
